_comment: Per-million-token rates in INR (USD rates x 96: $2 -> 192, $10 -> 960, $0.20 -> 19.2). input = uncached prompt tokens, cache_read = cached prompt tokens, output = completion tokens. 'currency' is the symbol shown before cost values. Defaults when a key is missing: currency '$', input 2.0, output 10.0, cache_read 0.2.
